title: Any Sensor. All Of Your Decisions.
summary: Discover how Meridian integrates existing occupancy data from various sensors to enhance space planning decisions.
body_markdown:
**Meridian now helps you make better space planning decisions by ingesting all your existing occupancy data sources, including other occupancy sensor providers.**


You have several lease decisions coming up over the next year, each with a deadline and cost attached, and none of them ends when the paperwork does. Give a floor back and the teams sitting on it need somewhere to go. Grow headcount instead and your attendance policy turns into a capacity question.


The trouble is that the data that would let you make these decisions confidently sits in various sensor providers and different systems.


Many of the corporate real estate and workplace teams we talk to have already invested in occupancy sensors, from XY Sense, Density, Butlr, Pointgrab, and others, for granular space usage insights. You might also have badge, video conferencing, WiFi and room booking data filling in a clearer picture.


** Between them, those systems hold most of what you need, but they don’t speak to one another. Replacing them with another provider would mean writing off hardware that works and months of surveys and installs across your sites, and your decision is due long before any of that finishes.


**Meridian now supports the integration of XY Sense, Density, Pointgrab, Butlr, and other sensor data**


Get more out of the sensors you already own. Meridian now supports integrations with other occupancy sensor providers, including XY Sense, Density, Butlr, Pointgrab, and others, so data from hardware you have already paid for comes in alongside your booking, video conferencing, WiFi and badge data. You keep the hardware, we take the data feed to help you make smarter, faster space planning decisions from a holistic view of your occupancy data.


Meridian connects your existing occupancy data to your four different types of space planning decisions you are already responsible for.


1.


Portfolio Right-Sizing: Model consolidation, reallocation, and lease exits.


2.


Occupancy Planning: Allocate teams and neighborhoods and plan for growth.


3.


Data-Driven Design: Quantify design impact before you commit.


4.


Workplace Automation: Automate routine decisions so your team can focus on strategy.


Several of our customers are already bringing their other occupancy sensor data into the Meridian platform. One global professional services firm is centralizing its analytics in Meridian while keeping hundreds of sensors it bought from another vendor, adding VergeSense sensors only where the coverage leaves a gap. Another gets its room occupancy from the video conferencing hardware that was already on the wall.


**One platform. All your decisions.**


Bringing all your existing occupancy data, including from other sensor vendors, helps you start closer to the finish line with a consolidated view of trends across your portfolio.


-


**See trends across your portfolio in one place:** Sensors from any provider, plus booking, video conferencing, WiFi, badge, and whatever you still keep in a spreadsheet, in a single picture of how your space is used. No new hardware required.


-


**Walk into the review with one answer:** Right-sizing, occupancy planning, design and automation all run off the same view, so you walk out of the review with a defensible recommendation.


-


**Keeps you flexible as conditions change:** Add a building, switch vendors, or inherit a system through an acquisition, and the data comes in alongside the rest. The decisions you make next year are not limited by the hardware you bought three years ago.


Bring whatever you have.[We will show you what Meridian does with it](https://www.vergesense.com/demo) .


****
